turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: It is as you say, my dear. I have seen to the wine and the rice, and everything is as you wished, for your comfort. May the spirits be kind to you and ease your passing, and may your son remember your wisdom always.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: Your father is a man of the earth, but he lacks a certain… foresight. Ensure that the eldest of your children, *your* children, remembers the value of land, of holdings. Do not let him squander what I have built for this family.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: I will, Mother. I understand your wishes regarding the land; I will certainly see to it. I trust my children will respect its value.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: The maid is a suitable match, I suppose; she possesses a certain… diligence. But remember, my son, a woman’s worth is not measured solely in her labors. Ensure she understands her place within this house, and that she bears sons, strong sons, to carry on my name.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: My son, you are a good man, and I trust you will heed your mother’s words. It is a weighty burden you carry, to safeguard our legacy, but I have faith you will do what is right, for the family’s sake. We all wish you and your bride a long and prosperous life together.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: She is right to be concerned; I will impress upon my sons the importance of maintaining our holdings. I hope they will listen and follow her guidance.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: Your father speaks of faith, but faith alone does not fill a granary. Ensure that your bride understands that strength lies not merely in bearing sons, but in securing their future – through alliances, through wisdom, through *careful* management. I have seen empires crumble from within, my son; do not let our family suffer a similar fate.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: I will endeavor to remember your words, Mother. I trust my bride will prove capable of understanding, with my guidance.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: Your bride possesses a quietness that is… useful. But quietness can be mistaken for weakness, and weakness invites exploitation. See to it that she understands the subtle currents of power; a woman who understands power can be a formidable shield, even if she wields it silently.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: Your mother speaks with such wisdom, my son. I... I only hope you can take it all in, and that your bride, she will also understand, and… and be a good help to you, as your mother wishes. It is a great responsibility, yes, a great responsibility.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: She is very clear in her instructions. I shall ensure my bride understands the importance of these matters, Father.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: It is true, my son, your mother has always been… insightful. I trust you will listen to her, and your bride will heed her words as well; a strong family is built on such foundations, isn’t it? We all want that, don't we?

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: I believe she is correct to emphasize strength, Father. I will speak with my bride about these… subtleties. It is important for her to understand.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: Yes, a strong family... it's everything, isn't it? Your mother, she’s always known these things so well. I just… I hope she’s not troubling herself too much with these matters now, my son, when she should be resting.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: She is concerned for our future, Father. I will do my best to uphold her wishes and ensure the family thrives.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: It is a good thing you listen to your mother, my son. She has always had a sharp mind, and wisdom comes from experience, doesn't it? I just pray that all these… arrangements… bring you and your bride much happiness and prosperity.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: It is… reassuring to know she is focused on these things, Father. I trust everything will proceed as she wishes, and that my bride will adapt well to her counsel.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: It’s good, it’s very good, that you both understand what she says. My heart... it feels a little uneasy with all these instructions, but she knows best, doesn't she? I just want everyone to be content and that the family continues strong, that’s all.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: Contentment is a fleeting thing, Wang Lung. Do not mistake my concerns for undue burden; a foundation built on shifting sands will surely collapse. Ensure your son understands the weight of his lineage, and that his bride proves worthy of it.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: I understand, Mother. I will strive to ensure my children appreciate the significance of our heritage and that my bride… contributes to its strength. It is my duty.

opening.speaker: O-lan
opening.text: Die I must, [GE-OMITTED:5:aa] [GE-OMITTED:6:aa] and well she serves me, [GE-OMITTED:7:aa] [GE-OMITTED:8:aa] because I must die, [GE-OMITTED:9:aa] [GE-OMITTED:10:aa] [GE-OMITTED:11:aa]

opening.speaker: O-lan
opening.text: Now she will be well, yet!

opening.speaker: O-lan
opening.text: [GE-OMITTED:40:aa] My son, [GE-OMITTED:41:aa] and my daughter, [GE-OMITTED:42:aa] there is she. [GE-OMITTED:43:aa]

opening.speaker: O-lan
opening.text: Well, and if I am ugly, [GE-OMITTED:50:aa] [GE-OMITTED:51:aa]
